purpose: Replaceable sample photography for three manually authored editable album collections; not live AI template output.
notes: Fictional scenes and people, not photographs of users or verified destinations.
Original PNG files copied unchanged from generated output; no CLI image editing.
Template selection removes sample photographs while preserving independently editable photo frames, text and decorations.
Commercial release still requires product, output-rights and print review.
